notes.title: September Update 1 - Bug Fixes and QoL
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613599/7800fdabebb3f5a8801183a35301cacc49cf8c5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 Demo Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Store/Inventory:[/b] selection frame now stays visible when buying, selling, or using items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ivy clones:[/b] no longer give scaling rewards (no more 12+ million Dust per battle!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Poison spell:[/b] description updated to show it deals 10–15% of [i]current HP[/i] per tick.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coins:[/b] can now be sold in the store, with a small supply always available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Equipped items:[/b] no more accidental selling of equipped items if you own duplicates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage Nullify skill:[/b] now has a clear visual effect when it triggers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Full Game Progress[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Boss battles for the [b]second and third maps[/b] have been set up in prototype form. The game can now be played through to the final boss, though there’s still lots of work left to do.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress made on a [b]new enemy[/b], our mysterious bat girl. She’ll spread her wings, claw, and drain you if you’re not careful. For now, we’re calling her [i]Batsy[/i], but we’d love to hear your name suggestions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update – Balance, QoL & Sneak Peek at Full Game Progress
notes.content:
[h3]We’ve rolled out a new demo update based on your feedback! This one focuses on smoothing out rough edges, improving pacing, and toning down some over-tuned mechanics.
[/h3][h3]

⚔️ Balance Changes
[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Ivy + Doe combo[/b][/p][list][*][p]No more Ivy + Doe right at the start. Early fights will be gentler, giving you time to gather Dust and learn the ropes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Doe:[/b] HP reduced by ~15%, healing power reduced by 30%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ivy:[/b] Clones are now weaker (about 50% of Ivy’s strength), with a distinct name and color.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Luck scaling[/b][/p][list][*][p]Luck was too strong and felt mandatory.[/p][/*][*][p]Effect reduced by 25%, but enemy rewards increased by 25% to keep progression steady.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemy boost after boss[/b][/p][list][*][p]The old system doubled enemy stats after the demo boss, which felt like scaling.[/p][/*][*][p]This boost has been removed. Enemies now stay consistent throughout the demo.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
🎲 QoL & Gameplay Flow[/h3][p][b]
Foxy’s Wheel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spin duration reduced by 30% (still suspenseful, but less waiting).[/p][/*][*][p]Ambush results now return you directly to Foxy, skipping the node map detour.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]First Mimic chest[/b][/p][list][*][p]The very first chest is now always safe. Later chests can still be Mimics, because that false sense of safety is part of the fun. Start [b][u]New Game[/u][/b] to avoid inconsistencies.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ivy’s pace[/b][/p][list][*][p]Her movement speed has been doubled to reduce the sluggish feel of her walk cycle.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sound settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Volume controls added to both the starting screen and active scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fine-tuning of individual sounds is still underway, but now you have general control everywhere.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3] 🔮 Full Game Progress Sneak Peek[/h3][p]
While polishing the demo, we’ve also advanced work on the full release:[/p][list][*][p][b]Map transitions:[/b] after a boss, you’ll move into new maps with fresh enemies, events, challenges, story beats, and bosses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hard battle nodes:[/b] the shield icon will mark special high-difficulty encounters with bigger rewards.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
🛠️ Minor Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Pause menu no longer overlaps with options (no more accidental “Quit to Desktop”).[/p][/*][*][p]Victory screen now auto-focuses and can be skipped with a single click.[/p][/*][*][p]Fair Trade event bug fixed (trading 0 MP no longer leaves you at 1 MP).[/p][/*][*][p]Skip rewards screen can be triggered even quicker.[/p][/*][*][p]Death screen duration reduced[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
Thank you all for the continued feedback, it’s helping us shape Twiwood Tales into something better with every update. Keep sharing your thoughts, and we’ll keep listening![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Update – New Tutorial, Balance Fixes & QoL Improvements
notes.content:
[p]We’ve just pushed out a fresh update to the [b]Twiwood Tales[/b] demo! This patch focuses on improving the early experience, balancing enemies and rewards, and making things smoother overall based on your feedback.[/p][p][b]Highlights:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Tutorial[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a tutorial for menus (can be skipped or replayed anytime).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Combat Flow[/b][/p][list][*][p]Defend now drains stamina when held.[/p][/*][*][p]Victory Screen and Boss intro can now be skipped.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sound Settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added volume controls to the Pause menu (coming to other menus soon).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies no longer scale with player level.[/p][/*][*][p]Items, rewards, and enemies rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Extra challenge unlocked after Boss defeat (tougher enemies & rewards).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]New shield added to Foxy’s rewards.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]QoL Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level Up button always visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Foxy stays in her intended position after affection is maxed.[/p][/*][*][p]Nodes map now flashes a Dust icon when you have enough Dust to level up.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Luck Factor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Luck now influences Steal technique.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]For best result, start [b]New Game[/b]

Thanks for all the feedback so far, it’s been shaping the demo in the right direction!
Keep playing, keep letting us know what feels good (or doesn’t).[/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613599/3d2ccf5e7a8d8aacb3de4447c1767319a483fa1c.png"][/img][b]

Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Punitor Natium[/i] technique could be learned multiple times.[/p][/*][*][p]Side improvement branches for [i]Punitor Natium[/i] were not purchasable.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Punitor Natium – Speed upgrades[/b] → now changed to [b]Duration upgrades[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Each level adds +3 seconds of technique performance time.[/p][/*][*][p]All levels together = +15 seconds total, on top of HST scaling.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Punitor Natium – Damage upgrades[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Each level adds +10% total slap damage.[/p][/*][*][p]All levels together = +50% total damage, on top of STR scaling.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Other Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pause menu can now be closed with the Esc key.[/p][/*][/list]
